Title: Inbox items with subject status and meta, per-status pill counts, pill narrowing and the template rows
PreConditions: Admin auth seeded with the admin id; the inbox returns 3 records across sent/pending/failed and the templates return 2 names
Steps: Render NotificationsPage at /admin/notifications, read the stat cards and the pill counts, click the failed pill then all, then read the template names
TestData: inbox: a sent email, a pending in_app with sentAt=null and recipient=device-token-abc, and a failed email; stats 12/1/9/1; templates welcome and exam-result
Expected: 4 KPI cards showing 12/1/9/1; 3 items each with a subject, a status badge and a "<relative time> - <recipient>" meta line; 5 pills with counts 3/1/1/1/0 and the all pill active; the failed pill leaves 1 item (Thong bao huy lop) and moves aria-pressed; all restores 3 items; the template count is 2 and the two names render in order

Title: The two failure shapes: the inbox has an error branch of its own while a failed templates read falls through to the no-data row
PreConditions: Admin auth; the inbox read rejects with ApiError 503 in the first render and the templates read rejects with ApiError 503 in the second
Steps: Render with the inbox failing and assert the error state, then unmount and re-render with the templates failing and assert the no-data row
TestData: inbox 1: rejected with ApiError 503; inbox 2: 1 sent record; templates 1: welcome and exam-result; templates 2: rejected with ApiError 503
Expected: A: the inbox error message renders with no item, neither the empty nor the loading branch, all five pill counts at 0, and the two template names still listed; B: the no-data template row renders with a count of 0 and no name, while the inbox still shows its single item and uses neither its error nor its empty branch

Title: The empty branch has three sources: both reads are withheld while pending and then resolve empty
PreConditions: Admin auth; GET /api/notifications/user/{id} and GET /api/notifications/templates stay pending until the test releases them, each with an empty array
Steps: Render and assert the pending state, release only the inbox read and assert the em-dash inbox row while the template table is still blank, then release the templates read and assert the no-data row
TestData: stats total 12; inbox and templates both resolve with an empty array
Expected: while pending the inbox spinner shows with no item and the template count reads 0 with no name and no no-data row; after the inbox settles the em-dash empty row shows and the template table is still blank; after the templates settle the no-data row shows, the count reads 0, all five pill counts are 0 with the all pill active, and the broadcast form is empty with a disabled send button

Title: Send stays disabled until recipient title and message are all non-blank, the two unsupported channels are locked, and a successful send clears title and message
PreConditions: Admin auth; the inbox and templates are empty and POST /api/notifications/send resolves with a sent record
Steps: Render the page, inspect the channel radios, fill the fields one at a time, whitespace-only the message, restore it, then click send
TestData: recipient=hocvien@ioes.test, title="  Thong bao ky thi giua ky  ", message="  Ky thi mo cua luc 8h ngay 10/10.  "
Expected: 3 channel radios where in-app is disabled, email is enabled and aria-checked, and push is disabled; the send button stays disabled until all three fields are set and is disabled again for a whitespace-only message; no POST before the click; the POST body is type=email plus recipient plus subject plus content with the title and message trimmed; after success the title and message inputs are empty, the recipient is kept, no error paragraph appears, the button shows the sent flash and is disabled again

Title: The three send-failure branches surface the 200-failed fallback, the ApiError message and the fallback again for a non-ApiError throw
PreConditions: Admin auth; POST is rejected or resolved per mode and the third mode swaps notificationApi.send for a plain Error
Steps: Fill the broadcast form and click send three times, changing the outcome each time
TestData: 1) resolves a record with status=failed 2) rejects with ApiError 409 3) rejects with a plain Error("boom-not-an-api-error")
Expected: 1) the fallback message appears and the typed title and message are NOT cleared; 2) the ApiError message "Ky thi da khoa, khong gui duoc thong bao." is shown instead; 3) the fallback message is shown again and the raw transport message never reaches the DOM; afterwards the form is still filled and the send button is enabled again

Title: /admin/notifications shows the stat cards, the inbox with its status pills, the template table and a correctly gated broadcast form with no console errors
PreConditions: web-admin storageState; /api/notifications/stats, /api/notifications/user/{id} and /api/notifications/templates stubbed by pathname; the send button is never clicked
Steps: 1. Visit /admin/notifications 2. Assert the 4 KPI cards 3. Assert 3 inbox items with their subjects, statuses and recipients 4. Read the 5 pill counts, click the failed pill then all 5. Assert the template count and names 6. Inspect the channel radios, then fill recipient/title/message one at a time
TestData: stats 12/1/9/1; inbox: a sent email to hocvien1, a pending in_app to device-token-abc and a failed email to hocvien3; templates welcome and exam-result
Expected: KPI values 12/1/9/1; 3 items with the expected subjects and statuses (the status badge is compared case-insensitively because of uppercase) and the right recipient in the meta; pill counts 3/1/1/1/0; the failed pill leaves 1 item; the template count is 2 with the names welcome and exam-result; the in-app and push channels are disabled while email is checked; the send button is disabled after the recipient only and after recipient+title, enabled after the message, and disabled again for a whitespace-only message; no send error is shown; console errors = 0
